answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a small stake that burns like an ember if peers catch it cheating, while honest work slowly polishes its record the way quartz is cut: each verified job adds a facet, and a jade-grade history is earned only after many independent attestations. Creating a thousand fake agents is cheap, but funding a thousand separate stakes and surviving a thousand peer reviews is not, so mass fakery stops paying.
